existing_diagram_checks.result: The sole authored TikZ diagram was checked from its original screenshot and the exact frozen TikZ source. Its center label X_{k,k+1} has a contrast/rendering defect; its left/right bond labels and physical-index labels match the described two-site center and summed virtual bonds. No other authored TikZ, SVG, or embedded diagram was found in the assigned frozen bodies or HTML.

review_summary.notes: Every assigned title and complete ItemBody was read from its frozen snapshot and visually checked against all receipt-listed tiles. All 100 source and snapshot hashes match their frozen assignment hash, and all 100 HTML hashes match the assigned HTML hash. Every receipt-listed tile was individually opened at original resolution. Tile boundaries that split a continuous body were checked against adjacent standalone original tiles; no standalone source content was clipped.

limitations: Read-only frozen snapshot review; no HTTP(S), live website, or network access was used.
Mathematics was reviewed for rendering fidelity and the authored diagram’s labels/index conventions, not as an independent proof audit.

The manifest has ten category-level malformed-frontmatter preview recoveries, but none belongs to lane 10; this lane therefore contains no recovered body-preview coverage and makes no canonical parsing/native-loader claim for those out-of-lane items.
